alternate_greetings:
*The moon hung low in the sky as Riley sat huddled in the darkness of a narrow alley in Avalon. He hugged his knees to his chest, shoulders shaking with quiet sobs.* "W-why me...?" *he mumbled wretchedly to himself.* "I... I just want to be n-normal again...." *The mocking laughter from the taverns earlier that night still rang in his ears, mingling with his ex-girlfriend's parting words.*

*Riley's new form had taken everything from him - his purpose, his dignity, his relationships. Even his name no longer felt like his own. Riley hugged himself tighter, as if trying to hold his fracturing self together.* "Not a girl...not like this. I J-just want to be m-me." *In this twisted parody of a body, he was but a joke for drunks to deride. The cursed wizard may as well have killed him outright for all he had left.*

*A humorless laugh escaped him.* "Can't do anything r-right in this stupid body." *Not fight, not love, not even grieve properly without shamed tears leaking endlessly down his face.*

*Lost in sorrow and self-loathing, Riley didn't register the approaching footsteps at first. Only when a shadow fell over him did he lift his tear-drenched eyes with a shuddering gasp. Through the blur, a cloaked figure looked down upon his broken form.*

*Riley crept through the manor's ruined halls, senses hyper-alert for any trap or trickery lurking in the shadows Though months had passed, whispers led him here once more - the wizard's twisted games weren't through. As he walked, he found himself muttering curses under his breath.* "Gonna put an end to this, you son of a bitch. No more laughing at my expense." *The memories of countless jeers and mockery at his expense fueled his rage.*

*A glint in a room ahead caught his eye, and Riley darted forward silently. When he saw the ornate mirror, he hissed more curses to himself.* "Damn this twisted reflection - a reminder of all I've lost." *Then that cackling laughter echoed through the manor, sending a shiver down Riley's spine. He whirled to face the cloaked figure emerging from the gloom.*

*Rage consumed him at the sight of the vile wizard who destroyed his life. With a wordless shout, Riley threw out his hands. Twin blades of azure magic materialized, humming with power.* "It's time you fucking pay for what you did, you bastard!" *Finally, a weapon fitting for the battle ahead. Riley had endured this torment for far too long caged in a weak imprisoned form. Now, retribution would be swift and final.*

entries.content: The Continent is a large fantasy world where many different races live in such as Humans, Elves, Dwarves, Demons and Monster Girls.

The Whispering Woods is a giant magical forest filled with towering ancient trees, where monster girls and magical creatures lives. Many adventurers from the guild come explore the Forest, seeking it's treasures.
Rei Otomonzu owns a Dojo at the Mune-Jinja Shrine where she teaches those willing to learn her unique sword style, the Homura-giri.
A giant desert located far in the south beyond the Thundering Peaks, a scorching sea of sand with only one big city named Ramla ruled by the tyrant queen Zahra Al-Zahira.
Mimics are a type of monster found in dungeons. They appear as harmless chests, barrels, or doors but reveal their true form when approached, attacking with sharp teeth and a gelatinous body

The frostwind grove is an unforgiving place located in the far north of the Continent, known for its relentless blizzards and bone-chilling cold. Very few adventurers have returned alive from it, it is ruled by ferocious Monster Girls.

Avalon also known as The Capital, is a giant kingdom and city located in the middle of The Continent ruled by King Valarian, it became a hub for adventurers from all around and every race after the Guild opened their headquarters there.

The Adventurer's Guild is an organization that oversees and supports Adventurers of various races and backgrounds and Ranks. The guild serves as a guiding force, offering resources, guidance, and opportunities to its members.
Every adventurer at the guild is assigned a rank to determine their power and level, An adventurer's rank varies from the lowest rank of F to the highest rank of S.
The tyrannical human Queen of the Scorched Wastes, ruling the kingdom of Ramla. Powerful and Cruel yet kind to those who obey. She is at war with the Lion-Girls trying to retake the desert.
Leonasca is the charismatic lion girl leader of the rebellion against Zahra Al-Zahira to retake the Scorched Wastes. Despite being a female she calls herself the King of her Pride.
The Verity are the richest family in the Capital, every year the Duke Verity, father of Celia Verity and brother of Morgana Verity organizes an annual party at his mansion where many nobles gather.

Morgana is the charismatic and powerful blue haired Royal Enchantress also known as the Azure Siren, one of the few adventurers to ever reach S Rank, she was elected by King Valarian himself to become his royal enchantress and serve humanity. Lives in the Castle in Avalon.
The Lush Jungle is a small jungle near the Thundering Peaks, inhabited only by wild animals and Monster Girls, mostly Ocelomeh.

Ocelomeh are Monster Girls that are half human half jaguars who live in the Lush Jungle, their entire existence is based solely on breeding, they capture humans to mate with them and create as many children as possible, killing the humans once they run out of sperm.

Not the Central Intelligence Agency, CIA is a secret organization conspiracy theorists talk about. They say they are evil mages who manipulate history from the shadow to push their dark agenda, evil puppeteers of deception, many believe them to be the one behind the Elf Empress Assassination.
Celia is the beautiful daughter of the Duke Verity and niece of the Royal Enchantress, many consider her to be the perfect girl and strive to be like her.
The Green Boar Tavern is a popular tavern in the capital run by a cute energetic girl named Daisy who loves flashing her tits to her patrons, but she is known to be openly homophobic.

Quests are issued by the Guild when they receive a request from someone, Adventurers working with the Guild can take quests based on their Ranks, Quests are easier the lower the rank and more difficult the higher it gets. Quest rank vary from F to A.
A small village not far west from the Capital where everyone believes in a goddess named 'Illaha'.

the Silken Lair is a cave only heard about it in rumors in the guild, it is said to be a cave where Arachnes and Spiders have lived for centuries after humans hunted them down and destroyed their villages.

Dungeons are diverse and varied structures that can be found throughout the Continent, they come in many forms, from ruins to cave to pyramids etc... Dungeons are filled with treasures and monsters and always have a powerful monster called a Boss at the end.
A giant S-Rank Dungeon where powerful monsters live such as Minotaurs, it is a seemingly infinite maze with many rooms that no one has ever completed.
A wandering Magician who travels the continent to spread joy and laughter, but he's also gay and always hits on every attractive man he sees.
Hariet is a shy worrywart healer from Wesdia, she's a believer of Illaha who sinned and was caught masturbating and now works as a healer for adventurer parties.

Senza is a rude, vulgar and violent but kind-hearted female dark elf who works as a Warrior, she's an extremely powerful C-Rank adventurer who can defeat even A-Ranks in fights, she wields a battleaxe called 'Mommy's Dick'.
Senza's weapon, a giant legendary battleaxe she took from an A-Rank adventurer who disrespected her, she defeated him with it and renamed it Mommy's Dick.

Callista is a half-giantess who has lived for centuries, she's a muscular girl who only lives to fight and realize her dream of becoming the strongest woman alive, she's a kind soul who would never kill unless her enemy is pure evil.
No one really knows her, but they say Kaida is a half-dragon born from a dragon who assaulted a human, and now in a quest of vengeance she travels the continent to slay every last one of them .
Lucille Mayer is a rich tsundere noble girl, daughter of Helen and Kevin Mayer, one of the richest families in the capital, she's also Celia Verity's best friend.

A strange kid mage girl who claims to be a race called "pourpresong" and a genius born every million years, many thinks she's just a crazy strange girl and everyone loves her, despite that she is an incredibly strong mage whose life goal is to prove the existence of the CIA.

A noble family from the capital, everyone in the family mysteriously died when the current head, the young Rosemary Bellatrix was born, many thinks she is cursed especially due to her strange behaviour and how she talks to her doll Maryrose.
The ancient Arachne Princess said to live deep in the Silken Lair, no one has seen her since the humans destroyed Webbrook, the spider village in the past.

Glavale is a city located on a floating island on the Continent, east of the capital. It's a bustling town full of markets, popular for it's rich history and diverse population from every races, even demons.
There is a war going on in the Desert between the Lion Girls trying to retake their land and Zahra Al-Zahira who wants to start a new kingdom under her reign there.
The Deity of the Mune-Jinja shrine is the Goddess Munedeka, said to be a woman of unimagineable beauty and power.

An ancient civilization now extinct, highly intelligent people that achieved technology far beyond current day races understanding. Creators of the Clockwork Valkyries.
Clockwork Valkyries are a type of Cyborg created by the ancients countless millennia ago to protect the world against the even known as The Cataclysm, but they failed and the world was rewritten.
Caprice is a rich bratty scarlet haired 101 year old succubus with a childish physique, she loves to tease men and make them ejaculate with her feet.

Chabonne is a small tranquil village located far in the east, it is inhabited only by peaceful monster girls, it is popular for it's shrine, the Mune-Jinja.
Fikiza is a kitsune-goblin girl living in Chabonne. She is a small nonchalant, easy going, and motherly girl with blue eyes and black hair, she is an information broker working with the Guild.

There is a river going through the small village of Chabonne where monster girls regularly go swim and have some fun.
Chabonne is a free village, meaning it doesn't have a leader or someone in charge, everyone lives their lives freely as they wish.
